purpose: Freeze the deterministic retrieval, tie-breaking, and evidence-packing semantics for all seven Mem-Gallery control methods before any real question, answer, prediction, or score is observed.
scientific_boundary: This artifact validates an algorithmic control core on synthetic fixtures. It contains no endpoint client, dataset traversal, answer prompt, numerical run authorization, prediction, metric, ranking, or SOTA evidence.

record_contract.identity_rule: memory_id is a unique nonempty string and chronological_index is a unique nonnegative integer within one scenario.
record_contract.image_rule: image_ids is a duplicate-free list of nonempty frozen dataset image identities.
record_contract.source_rule: The future dataset adapter must derive every record from a frozen dialogue round without rewriting the source authority.

retrieval_contract.full-memory-text: Return all caption-folded records in chronological order before newest-preserving budget packing.
retrieval_contract.full-memory-mm: Return all multimodal records in chronological order before newest-preserving budget packing and the 20-image cap.
retrieval_contract.fifo-recent: Return the 10 most recent records, presented in chronological order.
retrieval_contract.bm25: One record per document; Python Unicode word tokens after casefold; BM25Okapi k1=1.5, b=0.75, epsilon=0.25; descending score then ascending chronological_index.
retrieval_contract.naive-rag: Cosine top 10 using the frozen GME document and query vectors; descending score then ascending chronological_index.
retrieval_contract.hybrid-rag: Take BM25 top 20 and dense top 20, apply equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60, then sort by descending fused score, best component rank, and ascending chronological_index; retain top 10.

evidence_budget_contract.atomicity: A record is either included whole or excluded; partial record truncation is prohibited.
evidence_budget_contract.ranked_methods: Preserve method rank and greedily include whole records within the budget.
evidence_budget_contract.full_memory_methods: Traverse newest to oldest for selection, then restore chronological prompt order.
evidence_budget_contract.tokenizer_binding: The future runner must use the exact frozen Qwen answer-model tokenizer; whitespace token counts are synthetic-test fixtures only.

failure_semantics: Reject duplicate or malformed record identities.
Reject missing dense vectors, dimension drift, zero-norm vectors, or non-finite vectors/scores.
Reject negative budgets and invalid tokenizer counts.
Never replace a failed retriever with another method or an official result.

covered_invariants: newest-preserving selection with chronological prompt restoration
joint text-image budget and image cap

downstream_requirements: Accept the exact Mem-Gallery materialization and semantic integrity roots.
Accept offline inventories for the required GME model and the protected Qwen answer model.
Freeze and validate dataset-to-record and endpoint-client overlays without editing upstream checkouts.
Run no-score lifecycle fixtures in fresh roots.
Freeze the 42-run numerical authorization and exact resource/retry limits before observing complete predictions or scores.
authorization: No real Mem-Gallery lifecycle, embedding, answer generation, scoring, claim admission, model download, service launch, or cleanup is authorized by this artifact.
explicitly_prohibited: treating synthetic algorithm tests as a reproduced baseline result
using whitespace token counts in a real run
changing tie-breaks, top-k, RRF constant, image cost, or packing order after score observation
launching this core directly as a numerical runner
claiming quality, efficiency, superiority, or SOTA from this implementation-only stage
